name: City Run VR Ultimate: Free Indoor Running, Jogging & Cardio Fitness Workout
summary: ⚡ DOWNLOAD FOR FREE! ⚡ No treadmill required! Transform your living room into an open 3D city for indoor running, jogging and cardio fitness workouts on Meta Quest 3, 3S & 2. Features 3 workout modes, interactive AI coaches Adam & Sara, 3D smartwatch with live news & health tips, and custom MP3 music!
